answer: In an agent marketplace trading prism lenses, synthetic ivory, and lantern parts, each identity must lock a $100 bond for 30 days before it can submit bids, with one active bid allowed per bond. Creating new names therefore creates no free bidding capacity: an attacker running 1,000 identities must immobilize $100,000 for a month, paying financing costs and losing access to that capital throughout the lockup.
